F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.why_this_section_exists: LANE CU STOPPED rather than materialize a contract it had measured to be unsatisfiable. The HPO adjudication that followed CHANGED that contract. Both the finding and the adjudication are preserved here and in the companion addendum, so a future reader sees WHY the frozen contract has two shapes. Silently rewriting the original assumption is prohibited.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.F_CU_1_STATEMENT: The originally specified contract froze, for BOTH refusal verbs, entity_type='organization' AND entity_id = the attempted organization UUID, while ALSO authorising the reason TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED. Those three cannot hold at once.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.measured_proof_summary: audit_logs.entity_id is `uuid NOT NULL` at three agreeing layers - db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:3823, db/schema.ts:95, and no migration relaxes it. Meanwhile TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED arises exactly where no organization UUID exists: the selector's missing_organization branch, and lib/auth/database-context.ts:402 where getSelectedOrganizationId() returned null - which it does for an absent cookie AND for a malformed non-UUID value alike.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.why_the_additive_policy_did_not_resolve_: The LANE CK/CK-R2 finding F-1 was about the INSERT POLICY refusing the row. entity_id NOT NULL is a COLUMN constraint: no policy can satisfy it, because the row cannot be constructed at all. F-CU-1 is a second, independent obstacle.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.ADJUDICATION: TWO-SHAPE REFUSAL AUDIT SUBJECT CONTRACT - the audit row MUST truthfully identify the subject that actually exists at the refusal boundary. Resolved by truthful subject typing, NOT by widening the audit schema.
REJECTED: labelling a user-subject refusal as an organization entity
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION_CARRIED.STATUS: BINDING AND NOT REOPENED BY THE IMPLEMENTATION.

REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.binding: EXACTLY TWO forms are authorised. A row matching neither is a STOP, and the RLS policy is shaped so the database itself refuses it.
REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.governing_definition: TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED means NO VALID ORGANIZATION UUID ASSERTION EXISTS AT THIS REFUSAL BOUNDARY - absent, empty, malformed/non-UUID, or otherwise unavailable as a valid organization UUID. It does not mean 'the user did not click anything'.

FORM_A.name: NO VALID ORGANIZATION ASSERTION
FORM_A.do_not_manufacture_a_subject: Do NOT manufacture an organization subject merely because hostile or malformed input contained arbitrary bytes.

FORM_B.name: VALID ORGANIZATION UUID, MEMBERSHIP REFUSED
FORM_B.entity_id: the exact valid attempted/selected organization UUID
FORM_B.no_existence_lookup: No organization existence lookup may be added merely to emit this event. A deleted or nonexistent organization with a valid UUID remains observationally indistinguishable from non-membership - the property v1.0.4's S3-4 established and this node must not undo.
FORM_B.why_organization_id_is_still_NULL: The row is an event ABOUT the attempted organization, never one OWNED by that tenant. Setting organization_id would assert the very tenancy relationship the refusal denies, would require membership in the refused organization to write, and would make the row readable by that organization's members.

ACTION_SEMANTICS.forms_are_orthogonal_to_actions: BOTH actions may occur with EITHER form, depending on whether a valid organization UUID assertion exists at that action's boundary. The action names WHERE; the form names WHAT. The policy must not couple them.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.measured_boundary_mapping: tenancy.organization.selection_refused fires at the selector: its missing_organization branch is FORM A; its not_a_member branch is FORM B for a valid UUID and FORM A for a malformed one. tenancy.membership.revalidation_refused fires in lib/auth/database-context.ts: :402 is FORM A, :414 is FORM B - because getSelectedOrganizationId() has already guaranteed UUID validity for any non-null return.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_new_reasons: Do NOT create additional refusal reasons to distinguish malformed from absent input. The two reason values are exhaustive by adjudication.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_user_visible_change: This is an AUDIT CLASSIFICATION contract. It does NOT authorise changing user-visible selection or refusal semantics.

MALFORMED_ASSERTION_DISPOSITION.measured_hazard: The selector obtains `const requestedOrganizationId = (formData.get('organizationId') as string | null)?.trim()` and tests membership by comparing that RAW STRING against enumerated candidates. A malformed non-UUID therefore reaches the not_a_member refusal branch WITHOUT ever being UUID-validated.
MALFORMED_ASSERTION_DISPOSITION.binding: Classify the audit subject by VALID-UUID-ASSERTION, never by which redirect branch was taken. A malformed organization input is FORM A.
prohibitions: MUST NOT put a malformed string into audit_logs.entity_id
MUST NOT echo the raw malformed value into any audit metadata field, reason/before_json/after_json included
MUST NOT change the carrier-write authorization contract or the user-visible refusal branch
MUST NOT introduce a new refusal reason for the malformed case

UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.MEASURED_STATE: There is NO exported UUID-shape helper in the auth layer. UUID_PATTERN exists as a MODULE-PRIVATE const in FOUR modules - lib/auth/identity.ts:78, lib/auth/selected-organization.ts:79, lib/auth/session.ts:54, db/identity-context.ts:88 - all BYTE-IDENTICAL: /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i . None is exported. The zod z.string().uuid() usages in lib/admin/** and lib/pipeline/** are a service-module input-validation convention, not the auth-layer one.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.AUTHORIZED_FORM: lib/audit/tenancy-refusal.ts - a NEW file already in the ceiling - declares its OWN module-private UUID_PATTERN byte-identical to the established literal, becoming a fifth instance of an existing four-fold convention.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.WHY_NOT_EXPORT_THE_EXISTING_ONE: MEASURED CEILING CONSEQUENCE. All four host modules are OUTSIDE the 17-path ceiling; exporting from any would require an 18th path and fail the ceiling closed. This is why the adjudication's 'requires NO additional implementation path' holds.
UUID_SHAPE_MECHANISM.prohibited: Refactoring the four existing literals into a shared exported helper is a STOP in this node - a defensible cleanup, and somebody else's authorized mission.

AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.binding: ONE additive INSERT policy. A NARROW INSERT-SHAPE WALL, never an organization oracle.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.additive_not_replacing: The existing audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin policy is BYTE-UNCHANGED. This policy is ADDED beside it. Widening the old generic policy is a STOP.

exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_A_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = auth.uid()
exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_B_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER' AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id IS NOT NULL
exactly_one_subject_form_required.why_the_correlation_is_inside_the_policy: A policy that merely allowed reason IN (both) AND entity_type IN (both) would accept the CROSS PRODUCT - a FORM A row wearing entity_type='organization', or a FORM B row whose entity_id is the caller's own user id. Those are exactly the forgeries RA-SUBJECT-5 and RA-SUBJECT-7 catch, and the database must refuse them without trusting the emitter.

AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.what_the_database_CANNOT_prove: DISCLOSED. The policy proves a FORM B row carries SOME valid non-null uuid; it CANNOT prove that uuid is THE attempted organization, because that would require the forbidden organizations lookup. That obligation is an APPLICATION-LEVEL oracle discharged by RA-SUBJECT-8. An implementation claiming the policy proves it is wrong.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.semantic_guidance_only: The invariants above are binding; exact SQL formatting, the DROP-then-CREATE idiom and statement ordering follow existing repository migration conventions. This amendment is NOT permission to implement in this lane.
PROHIBITED: any change to the SELECT policy audit_logs_select_member_or_admin
service-role or any other privileged connection
RLS bypass of any form, including SET ROLE or a BYPASSRLS role
a new table, schema, function, enum or foreign key
an organizations-table existence lookup inside the policy
writing the refusal to a different table to dodge the policy

V1_0_4_PROHIBITIONS_ARE_SCOPED_TO_S3_COR.why_this_clause_is_load_bearing: v1.0.4 AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.no_workaround forbids S3 from using 'a new or altered policy' to emit these verbs. Read without scope, that would forbid exactly what this node does, and an auditor comparing the two artefacts would read a contradiction.
V1_0_4_PROHIBITIONS_ARE_SCOPED_TO_S3_COR.the_scoping: That prohibition binds S3 CORE, which had no authority to add a policy and would therefore have been SIDESTEPPING the existing predicate. This node is the NAMED SUCCESSOR v1.0.4 pointed to, acting under its own governed authority with an explicit protected grant and migration.
V1_0_4_PROHIBITIONS_ARE_SCOPED_TO_S3_COR.the_material_difference: A SIDESTEP reaches the table by a route that AVOIDS the governing predicate. This node leaves audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin byte-unchanged and adds a second, narrower permissive policy admitting exactly two row shapes.
V1_0_4_PROHIBITIONS_ARE_SCOPED_TO_S3_COR.honest_disclosure: PostgreSQL ORs permissive policies for the same command, so this DOES enlarge the insertable set - that is what an additive policy is. The enlargement is bounded to the two adjudicated shapes and is separately proven so by RA-SUBJECT-3 through RA-SUBJECT-8. Claiming the write surface is unchanged would be false.
V1_0_4_PROHIBITIONS_ARE_SCOPED_TO_S3_COR.the_other_prohibitions_remain_absolute: service-role, RLS bypass, SECURITY DEFINER and writing to a different table remain STOPS for THIS node exactly as for S3 core.

READABILITY_CONTRACT.binding: NULL-org refusal rows - BOTH forms - are readable ONLY by superadmin under the current governed audit model. No ordinary organization member gains read access.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.NO_SELECT_POLICY_CHANGE_AUTHORIZED: The required behaviour ALREADY HOLDS and is frozen, not implemented.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.measured_proof: db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:8829 - audit_logs_select_member_or_admin USING ((organization_id = ANY (public.current_user_org_ids())) OR public.current_user_is_super_admin()). With organization_id NULL, `NULL = ANY (...)` evaluates to NULL, never TRUE, so the member arm admits the row for NOBODY - including members of the organization named in a FORM B entity_id. Only the super-admin arm can admit it.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.no_membership_conferred_by_entity_id: entity_id is DESCRIPTIVE SUBJECT METADATA ONLY. No membership, read grant or tenancy relationship may be inferred from it. No FK from entity_id to organizations is introduced, and none may be.
READABILITY_CONTRACT.no_existence_oracle: A refused subject cannot read the row their own refusal produced: they are not a superadmin, and the row carries no organization_id that could admit them.

SECURITY_INVARIANTS.binding: Carried forward from v1.0.4 SECURITY_INVARIANTS unchanged, plus the following node-specific ones.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.audit_write_is_not_a_capability: The refusal insert path must never give the refusal branch a capability the success path lacks. It is a bounded logging shape, not a privilege.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.no_arbitrary_generic_audit_write: The policy must make it impossible to use the refusal path to write an arbitrary generic audit event - enforced by pinning both json columns, both request-metadata columns, organization_id, project_id, the action set and the correlated reason/subject form simultaneously.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.no_write_anything_channel_into_entity_id: FORM A pins entity_id = auth.uid(), so a caller cannot choose it. FORM B permits a caller-supplied uuid, bounded to uuid type by the column and to the actual attempted value by RA-SUBJECT-8.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.no_raw_input_reflection: Attacker-controlled bytes must never reach any column of the row. This is why a malformed assertion is FORM A rather than 'FORM B with whatever was submitted'.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.no_existence_oracle: Neither the emitter nor the policy may perform an organizations lookup, and the row is unreadable by the refused party.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.cookie_tampering: A forged or stale carrier produces a refusal and therefore an audit row; it never produces a principal. Unchanged from S3 core.

TEST_CONTRACT.binding_by_id_not_restatement: The node's controls bind by id against docs/ops/tenancy/MULTI_ORG_TENANT_SCOPE_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json and the ids below. No competing test manifest is created by this mission.

a membership-revalidation refusal can be inserted
only the two authorized actions are accepted
only the two authorized reasons are accepted
before_json and after_json must be NULL

ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-1: NO valid org assertion yields entity_type='user' AND entity_id=auth.uid() (FORM A accepted).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-2: Valid UUID + no membership yields entity_type='organization' AND entity_id = the attempted UUID (FORM B accepted).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-3: Malformed organization input MUST NEVER be stored as entity_id, MUST classify as FORM A, and MUST NOT leak raw malformed bytes.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-4: A sentinel organization UUID is PROHIBITED.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-5: FORM A with entity_type='organization' MUST FAIL (database-level).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-6: FORM A with entity_id != auth.uid() MUST FAIL (database-level).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-7: FORM B with entity_type='user' MUST FAIL (database-level).
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-8: FORM B emitted with a DIFFERENT valid UUID than the actual attempted valid UUID MUST FAIL the APPLICATION-LEVEL oracle. Application-level BY NECESSITY - the database cannot prove it - and the only control between 'a uuid' and 'the right uuid'.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-9: An ordinary member cannot read either NULL-org form, including a member of the organization named in a FORM B entity_id.
ADJUDICATION_CONTROLS.RA-SUBJECT-10: A superadmin can read both forms.

MUTATION_CONTROLS.binding: Mutations must alter REAL BYTES in the working tree, fail a NAMED oracle, and revert BYTE-EXACTLY.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.NO_MUTATION_MAY_BE_DOCUMENTARY: A mutation whose only evidence is a sentence in the evidence artifact is a STOP.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.minimum_set: At minimum, one mutation per RA-SUBJECT-5, -6, -7 and -8, since those four are the forgeries the whole two-shape design exists to refuse.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.CRLF_HAZARD: .gitattributes pins docs/**, db/baseline/** and db/prepared/** to LF while other text files round-trip through core.autocrlf. A byte-exact revert must be verified AS BYTES.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.pristine_capture_discipline: Capture the pristine copy BEFORE the mutation loop begins, never inside it - capturing inside poisons the baseline of a two-edit mutation.

REAL_PG_CONTRACT.binding: The workflow MUST execute ONLY the refusal-audit real-PostgreSQL contract and MUST set the required live-PG environment explicitly.
must_fail_if: any required refusal probe is absent
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.why_dedicated: A real-PG suite that silently SKIPS is indistinguishable from one that passes, and describe.skipIf is this repository's established live-PG idiom. 'The tests were green' is not evidence unless collection and probe execution are asserted NON-ZERO.
PROHIBITED: relying on generic CI to collect the suite incidentally
reusing the M2 workflow as a substitute
REAL_PG_CONTRACT.existing_harness_note: tests/authenticated-database-context.test.ts already demonstrates the idiom - a real uellix_app connection with a two-tenant fixture under describe.skipIf(!LIVE), with rollback. The new harness may follow it but must not weaken skip detection.

POLICY_PROBE_CONTRACT.binding: TARGETED at public.audit_logs. MUST NOT assert a global policy count such as 108.
POLICY_PROBE_CONTRACT.why_not_a_global_count: A global count couples this node to every unrelated policy in the database, and can stay correct while THIS table's policies are wrong, because two errors elsewhere can cancel.
POLICY_PROBE_CONTRACT.measured_basis: db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql declares exactly two policies on public.audit_logs, at :8822 and :8829. The only audit_logs policy statements in db/migrations/ are in 0031_rls_core.sql and 0042_fib_audit_insert_policy.sql. No third policy exists at INTEGRATION_SHA.
